$comment: Player movement (tiles/s). Screen-aligned iso mapping (W = up-screen). Speed = walkSpeed x sprintMul (while sprinting with stamina) x encumbrance x wetness x MoveSpeed buffs. Encumbrance: above encumberedFrom x maxWeight the multiplier falls linearly to encumberedMinMul at full weight. Wetness slows by up to wetSlowMul. swimTiles (ADR-107): terrain ids players may enter (overrides worldgen unwalkableTiles for player movement only; AI pathing still avoids them) at x swimSpeedMul; anything standing on one plays AnimState.Swim. ADR-125: walkSpeed cut 4 -> 2.6 (jog; sprint 4.16) so vehicles (12.5-18) are 3-4.3x sprint; walkAnimRefSpeed = the speed the character walk art was authored at (client plays walk at walkSpeed / walkAnimRefSpeed so feet do not slide).
